LESSON: MONEY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.6 Temperature (6 lessons) • temperature conditions • units of mea
Topic 3.7: Money
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money, part of Measurements 3.6 Temperature (6 lessons) • temperature conditions • units of mea in Grade 7 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: Why do we use money in daily activities? 2. What considerations would we make when buying or selling? 3. What is involved in mobile money transactions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. role play shopping and selling activities involving profit, loss, discount and commission

2. work out profit and loss involving different activities and settings

3. work out the percentage profit/loss from the role play activities

4. work out discount and percentage discount from model shopping activities

5. work out commission and percentage commission from the role play activities

6. identify different types of bills and read the components of bills

7. prepare bills for different items and expenses 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. role play shopping and selling activities involving profit, loss, discount and commission
2. work out profit and loss involving different activities and settings
3. work out the percentage profit/loss from the role play activities
4. work out discount and percentage discount from model shopping activities
5. work out commission and percentage commission from the role play activities
6. identify different types of bills and read the components of bills
7. prepare bills for different items and expenses 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Money together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: as the learner works out discounts, commissions, and mobile money as well as postal

charges and bills.

● Communication and Collaboration: as the learner role plays on negotiating for discounts and commissions.

● Citizenship: as the learner works out discounts, commissions, and mobile money in Kenyan currency.

● Self-efficacy: as the learner role plays on negotiating for discounts and commissions.

35

Values:
● Patriotism: as the learner role plays and works out paying bills in Kenyan currency.

● Integrity: as the learner pays bills and appreciates the use of money.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial Literacy: as the learner works out any discounts, commissions, and mobile money as well as postal charges and

bills.

● Decision-making: as the learner uses money to pay bills and postal charges.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Pre-Technical Studies: as the learner works out bills, discounts, commissions and postal charges.

● Languages: as the learner gathers information on postal services and charges.
